standardized.notes: RFC 1493 explicitly bases its bridge-management model on IEEE 802.1D-1990; primary IEEE publication metadata should be added separately.

roles: standardize MAC bridge behavior between LAN segments
define bridge identifiers ports forwarding and topology state used by implementations and management systems
addressing: Bridge forwarding operates on LAN/MAC addresses; bridge identity incorporates a bridge priority component and MAC-address-derived identity in the IEEE model referenced by RFC 1493.
routing_or_forwarding: Transparent link-layer learning/filtering/forwarding between LAN segments with loop-free active topology selected by spanning-tree procedures.

operations.monitoring: Bridge and STP state later exposed through the Bridge MIB, including root, root cost, root port, topology-change counters, forwarding database and per-port state.
operations.diagnostics: Topology and forwarding state are operational diagnostics; product-specific console procedures require vendor records.
operations.remote_management: Mapped into SNMP Bridge MIB objects in RFC 1493.
operations.failure_behavior: Redundant physical topology is reduced to a loop-free active spanning topology; topology changes trigger recomputation/state changes.

open_questions: Acquire and register the exact IEEE 802.1D-1990 primary standard text and publication metadata.

Trace later RSTP/MSTP successors without back-projecting their states and timers into 1990 STP.
